primary.title: Returning to India? How RNOR status can help NRIs save tax on foreign income
primary.summary: During the RNOR phase, local income rules mirror those applicable to ordinary residents. Any revenue sourced within India—such as domestic salary, rental proceeds from local property, or fixed deposit interest—remains fully taxable and must be reported in the ITR
